sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ref, also known as "The Host", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov and Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: The Arena host who organizes pit fights across Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Ref is initially locked in the main game, and can be unlocked through Skier's quest Easy Money - Part 1.

sections.heading: Wares
sections.text:
- Well-modified weapons
- Rare weapon mods
- Rare armor, armor plates, helmets, and backpacks
- Packs of rare ammunition
- Containers
- Barter items
- Signal pistol and ammunition
- Keys to rooms of fallen Arena gladiators

sections.heading: Loyalty Level Requirements
sections.text:
| Loyalty Lvl | Required Lvl | Required Rep |
| Lvl 2 | 15 | 0.25 |
| Lvl 3 | 25 | 0.50 |
| Lvl 4 | 35 | 1.20 |

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
Note: To get access to Ref in the main game you need to complete the quest Easy Money - Part 1 from Skier.
- See the quests overview page

sections.heading: Item transfer service
sections.text:
- After the completion of his quest To Great Heights! - Part 3, Ref offers item and currency transfers between the Arena and the main game for main characters.
- After the completion of his quest Jack of All Trades, Ref offers item and currency transfers between the Arena and the main game for seasonal characters.

The following items can be transferred:
- GP coins
- Lega Medals
- Roubles
- Locked crates

sections.heading: Main character
sections.text:
- 350 GP coins
- 5 Lega Medals
- Roubles:
  - ₽1,000,000 for "Standard" arena game edition
  - ₽1,500,000 for "Ryzhy" arena game edition

sections.heading: Seasonal character
sections.text:
- 150 GP coins
- 2 Lega Medals
- 400,000 Roubles
- 3 Equipment crate (Rare)
- 3 Supply crate (Rare)
- 3 Valuables crate (Rare)
- 3 Weapon crate (Rare)

sections.heading: Transfer fees
sections.text:
- Roubles: 15% of the amount
- Items: 5% of the value
Fees are reduced by the Charisma skill and loyalty level with Ref.
